description: This file defines the PatternEndpointProvider class responsible for providing endpoints based on a set of endpoint pattern configurations. It includes methods for constructing the provider, invoking it with arguments to retrieve endpoints, and expanding endpoint configurations with specific scheme, service, and region details.

classes.name: PatternEndpointProvider
classes.description: A class that provides AWS endpoint URLs based on pattern configurations and runtime parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with a set of endpoint patterns.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Retrieves an endpoint configuration based on input arguments like service and region.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands a pattern configuration into a full endpoint URL with scheme, service, and region.
